columns.doc: The writer that produced the row ('edgar'). One writer per source.
columns.name: source

columns.doc: XBRL namespace as the filer reported it ('us-gaap', 'dei').
columns.name: taxonomy

columns.doc: Start of a duration; null for an instant.
columns.name: period_start

columns.doc: End of a duration, or the instant.
columns.name: period_end

columns.doc: The value as filed. Never imputed: an absent fact has no row.
columns.name: value

columns.doc: The day the filing carrying this value was filed: the knowable date the cut reads.
columns.name: filed_date

columns.doc: The filing's accession number: the source_ref.
columns.name: accession

columns.doc: SEC's calendar frame, when SEC assigned one.
columns.name: frame

columns.doc: Dimensional qualifiers as JSON; null when undimensioned (all of companyfacts).
columns.name: dimensions

columns.doc: The module that wrote the row.
columns.name: extractor

columns.doc: That module's version when it wrote the row.
columns.name: extractor_version

columns.doc: Why a non-present status was recorded; null when present.
columns.name: reason

filing_columns.doc: The filing's accession number, as its data rows carry it.
filing_columns.name: accession

filing_columns.doc: The form SEC's submissions document lists for the filing.
filing_columns.name: form

filing_columns.doc: SEC's filing date, which the filing's data rows carry as filed_date.
filing_columns.name: filing_date

filing_columns.doc: When SEC accepted the filing (acceptanceDateTime), in UTC with no zone stored: the moment the cut reads.
filing_columns.name: accepted_at

order_columns.doc: The row's position in the source response, so a replay reproduces the filer's order.
order_columns.name: source_position

order_columns.doc: The content id of the data object holding the row.
order_columns.name: object

order_columns.doc: The row's index in that object, in its stored order.
order_columns.name: row
